name: Fogwharf · English
description: Find the second ship. As the fog clears, a path to the still unnamed town appears.
author: Worldlines Canvas / AIRP

characters.description: Technician with a purple glowing prosthetic hand. Personally interested in the rudder clasp. Makes light comments but won’t talk about crimes she didn’t see.
characters.name: Vera

characters.description: An elf knight guarding the empty box and gangway. Chooses words according to the evidence.
characters.name: Silver Kite

characters.description: A lighthouse keeper with scars. Accepts the twelve minutes after lights-out that they themselves caused, but cannot explain unknown pursuing ships.
characters.name: Old Mo
